classification.difficultyReason: Infer the trapezium height, add rectangular and trapezoidal cross-sectional areas, then multiply by prism length.

content.prompt: Calculate the volume of this prism.

spec.description: Composite prism with upper rectangle 8 mm wide and 8 mm high above a trapezium with bottom width 15 mm. Total cross-section height 18 mm; prism length 30 mm. The front and longitudinal boundaries between portions are retained.

answer.worked:
The trapezium height is $18-8=10\text{ mm}$.
$\begin{aligned}A_1&=8\times8\\A_1&=64\text{ mm}^2\\A_2&=\frac{8+15}{2}\times10\\A_2&=115\text{ mm}^2\\V&=(64+115)\times30\\V&=5370\text{ mm}^3\end{aligned}$
